7Read the school report. Mark T or F, then correct the false statements.

The students in 6-D have important jobs for Children’s Day. Their teacher, Mr Kaya, puts a list on the board. Zeynep’s team hangs red flags in the gym. They also make yellow paper stars. İpek gives the welcome speech. She practises after breakfast every day and feels confident because her sister helps her. Berk reads a poem at 09.25. (1) Hello! I am Ece from class 6-D. Let me describe a school day.

(2) I usually cycle with my neighbour. Our first lesson begins at 09.00.

(3) During breaks, I play table tennis. I visit the library on Tuesdays and Fridays.

(4) For Children’s Day, I am responsible for hanging flags. I check them every morning.

(5) I feel pleased and excited. I hope you enjoy our show!
